mapper.sql: select tstock.id, tstock.area_id, tstock.location_id, tstock.material_id, tstock.batch_code, tstock.unit_id, tstock.count, tstock.available_count, tstock.status, tstock.is_freeze, tstock.origin_type, tstock.tray_id, tstock.begin_date, tstock.end_date, tstock.produced_date, tstock.position, tstock.remark, tstock.create_by, tstock.create_time, tstock.update_by, tstock.update_time, tstock.dept_id, tstock.dept_name, tstock.del_flag from t_stock tstock
mapper.select:
select s.id, s.area_id, s.position, s.location_id, s.material_id, s.batch_code, s.unit_id, s.count, s.available_count, s.status, s.is_freeze, s.origin_type, s.dept_id, s.dept_name, s.tray_id, s.begin_date, s.end_date, s.produced_date, s.remark, s.del_flag, t.code as trayCode, m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName,m.specifications , tu.name as unitName, tl.code as locationCode, tl.name as locationName, tl.location_type, tr.name as reservoirName, ta.name as areaName, tuc.max_unit_name from t_stock as s left join t_tray as t on s.tray_id = t.id left join t_material m on s.material_id = m.id left join t_unit tu on m.unit_id = tu.id left join t_location tl on s.location_id = tl.id left join t_reservoir tr on tl.reservoir_id = tr.id left join t_area ta on s.area_id = ta.id left join t_unit_config tuc on s.material_id = tuc.material_id
s.del_flag = '0' AND s.count > 0 and s.batch_code = #{stock.batchCode} and s.area_id = #{stock.areaId} and s.tray_id = #{stock.trayId} and t.code like concat('%', #{stock.trayCode}, '%') and s.unit_id = #{stock.unitId} and s.location_id = #{stock.locationId} and s.is_freeze = #{stock.isFreeze} and s.material_id = #{stock.materialId} and s.dept_id = #{stock.deptId} and s.position like concat('%', #{stock.position}, '%') and s.origin_type = #{stock.originType} and m.code like concat('%', #{stock.materialCode}, '%') and m.name like concat('%', #{stock.materialName}, '%') and tl.name like concat('%', #{stock.locationName}, '%') and tl.code like concat('%', #{stock.locationCode}, '%')
order by s.dept_id
mapper.delete: update t_stock set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_stock set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select s.batch_code , s.material_id , s.count, m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName, tu.name as unitName from t_stock s left join t_material m on s.material_id = m.id left join t_unit tu on m.unit_id = tu.id where s.del_flag = '0' and s.tray_id = #{trayId}

select a.id, a.count, a.batch_code, m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName, tu.name as unitName, tl.name as locationName, tr.name as reservoirName, ta.name as areaName, tt.code as trayCode from t_stock a left join t_material m on a.material_id = m.id left join t_unit tu on m.unit_id = tu.id left join t_location tl on a.location_id = tl.id left join t_reservoir tr on tl.reservoir_id = tr.id left join t_area ta on a.area_id = ta.id left join t_tray tt on a.tray_id = tt.id where a.del_flag = '0' and m.code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%') and m.name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%') and tl.name like concat('%', #{locationName}, '%') and a.batch_code like concat('%', #{batchCode}, '%') order by a.create_time desc

SELECT tm.id,ts.batch_code as batchNumber FROM t_stock ts INNER JOIN t_material tm on ts.material_id=tm.id WHERE ts.location_id in
#{locationId}

SELECT ts.id,ts.material_id, tr.name as reservoirName ,tl.name as locationName,tt.code,tsm.library_count as `count`,tsm.available_count,tt.tray_category FROM t_stock ts INNER JOIN t_material tm on ts.material_id=tm.id INNER JOIN t_stock_main tsm on tsm.material_id=tm.id INNER JOIN t_location tl on tl.id=ts.location_id AND tl.del_flag='0' INNER JOIN t_reservoir tr on tr.id=tl.reservoir_id AND tr.del_flag='0' INNER JOIN t_tray tt on tt.id=ts.tray_id AND tt.del_flag='0' WHERE ts.material_id=#{materialId} AND ts.del_flag='0' AND tm.del_flag='0'

select a.id, a.material_id , a.location_id , a.batch_code , a.produced_date , a.count , a.available_count , a.is_freeze , a.tray_id , m.expiration_date ,m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName, m.specifications , m.description , date_add(a.produced_date, INTERVAL m.expiration_date DAY) as expiryDate, tu.name as unitName,b.name as categoryName from t_stock a left join t_material m on a.material_id = m.id left join t_unit tu on m.unit_id = tu.id left join t_category b on m.category_id = b.id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.produced_date is not null and m.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%')

select m.name materialName, m.code materialCode, m.description description, c.name categoryName, s.count count, u.name unitName, s.batch_code batchCode, ifnull(s.update_time,s.create_time) deadTime, DATEDIFF(now(),ifnull(s.update_time,s.create_time)) deadDayCount from t_stock s left join t_material m on m.id=s.material_id left join t_category c on c.id=m.category_id left join t_unit u on u.id=m.unit_id where s.del_flag = '0' and date_add(now(), INTERVAL -#{dzpDate} DAY)>ifnull(s.update_time,s.create_time) and m.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%') order by deadTime desc

select m.name materialName, m.code materialCode, s.batch_code batchCode, u.name unitName, m.unit_price unitPrice, s.count count, s.count*m.rough_weight weight, s.count*m.unit_price totalPrice, s.create_time createTime, DATEDIFF(now(),s.create_time) stockAge from t_stock s left join t_material m on m.id=s.material_id left join t_unit u on u.id=m.unit_id where s.del_flag = '0' and m.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%') and s.batch_code like concat('%',#{batchCode},'%') and s.create_time between #{beginDate} and #{endDate} order by s.create_time desc

select m.name materialName, m.code materialCode, u.name unitName, c.name categoryName, s.batch_code batchCode, r.name reservoirName, l.name locationName, s.count count from t_stock s left join t_material m on m.id=s.material_id left join t_unit u on u.id=m.unit_id left join t_category c on c.id=m.category_id left join t_location l on l.id=s.location_id left join t_reservoir r on r.id=l.reservoir_id where s.del_flag = '0' and m.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%') and s.batch_code like concat('%',#{batchCode},'%') and r.id=#{reservoirId} order by s.id desc

select a.id, a.batch_code , a.material_id , a.count , a.available_count , m.name as materialName from t_stock a left join t_material m on a.material_id = m.id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.tray_id = #{trayId}

select a.id, a.batch_code,a.location_id, a.material_id , a.count , a.available_count from t_stock a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.id in
#{stockId}

select b.id , b.count , b.batch_code , b.is_freeze , a.material_name , a.material_code from t_material_detail a left join t_stock b on a.material_id = b.material_id and a.batch_code = b.batch_code where a.del_flag = '0' and b.del_flag = '0' and a.rfid = #{rfid} and (a.location_id is null or a.location_id = b.location_id)

select ifnull(sum(t1.available_count),0) from t_stock t1 left join t_location t2 on t1.location_id = t2.id where t1.del_flag = 0 and t1.is_freeze = 0 and t2.del_flag = 0 and t2.location_type = #{type} and t1.material_id = #{materialId}

select sum(t1.sum * t2.unit_price) from (select material_id, sum(count) as sum from t_stock where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' group by material_id) t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id

select t3.name, t1.count as value from (select material_id, sum(count) as count from t_stock where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' group by material_id) t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id left join t_category t3 on t2.category_id = t3.id
where t3.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')

select ifnull(sum(count),0) from t_stock where del_flag = '0'
and DATEDIFF(now(),create_time) < 365
and 1095 > DATEDIFF(now(),create_time) >= 365
and 1825 > DATEDIFF(now(),create_time) >= 1095
and DATEDIFF(now(),create_time) >= 1825

select ifnull(sum(t1.count * t2.unit_price),0) as amount, count(1) as count from (select material_id, sum(count) as count from t_stock where del_flag = '0'
and DATEDIFF(now(),create_time) < 365
and 1095 > DATEDIFF(now(),create_time) >= 365
and 1825 > DATEDIFF(now(),create_time) >= 1095
and DATEDIFF(now(),create_time) >= 1825
group by material_id) t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id

select t.stock_min as stockMin, t.count, t.id as materialId, t.name as materialName, t.categoryName from (select t1.id, t1.name, t1.stock_min, ifnull(t2.count, 0) as count, t3.name as categoryName from (select id, stock_min, name, category_id from t_material where del_flag = '0' and stock_min is not null) t1 left join (select sum(count) as count, material_id from t_stock where del_flag = '0' group by material_id) t2 on t1.id = t2.material_id left join t_category t3 on t1.category_id = t3.id) t where t.stock_min > t.count order by t.stock_min - t.count desc limit 10

select t.stock_max as stockMax, t.count, t.id as materialId, t.name as materialName, t.categoryName from (select t1.id, t1.name, t1.stock_max, ifnull(t2.count, 0) as count, t3.name as categoryName from (select id, stock_max, name, category_id from t_material where del_flag = '0' and stock_max is not null) t1 left join (select sum(count) as count, material_id from t_stock where del_flag = '0' group by material_id) t2 on t1.id = t2.material_id left join t_category t3 on t1.category_id = t3.id) t where t.count > t.stock_max order by t.count - t.stock_max desc limit 10
